features.name: log_p1
features.description: Logarithmic transformation of the absolute count feature P1 to compress extreme values.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses large values, reducing the influence of extreme outliers on the SVM margin and improving gradient stability.

features.name: p15_ratio
features.description: Ratio between P15p1 and P15p3, with a small constant added to the denominator to prevent division by zero.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a relative proportion that might linearly separate instances better than absolute values, providing a new projection axis.

features.name: h_composite_score
features.description: Average of three housing-related proportion features (H2p2, H8p2, H13p1).
features.expected_model_benefit: Averages multiple indicators to create a smoother, more robust continuous feature that reduces noise for the linear decision boundary.

features.name: p16_threshold_indicator
features.description: Binary indicator for whether P16p2 exceeds 0.7.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a hard margin split for the SVM to utilize as a categorical intercept shift, capturing non-linear threshold effects.

features.name: p5_p11_interaction
features.description: Multiplicative interaction between P5p1 and P11p4.
features.expected_model_benefit: Explicitly provides a multiplicative interaction term to the linear model, which cannot learn feature crosses natively.

features.name: h10_deficit
features.description: The inverse or deficit of the H10p1 proportion.
features.expected_model_benefit: Inverts the feature space to potentially align the gradient more naturally with the decision boundary.

features.name: p6_h8_ratio
features.description: Ratio of P6p2 to H8p2, smoothed with a 0.01 constant.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the relative balance between two proportions, offering a new linear projection axis that may correlate strongly with the outcome.

features.name: p14_p27_sum
features.description: Sum of P14p9 and P27p4 proportions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates two potentially correlated proportions into a single continuous severity measure, reducing dimensionality and collinearity.

features.name: h40_extremity
features.description: Measures the absolute deviation of H40p4 from its midpoint (0.5), scaled to a 0-1 range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Transforms a mid-point centered feature into a monotonic extremity score, making it linearly separable if extreme values share similar outcomes.

features.name: p18_scaled
features.description: Scales the P18p2 proportion by a factor of 100.
features.expected_model_benefit: Scales up a very small proportion to ensure its gradient updates and margin contributions are comparable to other features in the SVM.

features.name: housing_quality_assessment
features.description: A semantic evaluation of overall housing quality based on the combination of H-prefix features, assessing structural and occupancy conditions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic, expert-like summary score that linear models can use as a strong primary axis for separation.

features.name: population_density_risk
features.description: A semantic assessment of risk factors associated with population density and demographic distributions derived from P-prefix features.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encapsulates complex demographic interactions into a single continuous severity measure, ideal for linear margin optimization.
